problem: A data set has a mean $\overset{¯}{x}=14.5$ and an unknown standard deviation. An observation of the data set has the value $x=20$ and $z$-score $z=2.2.$ Find the standard deviation of the data set.

feedback.worked_solution:
To compute the value of an observation $x$ which yields a given $z$-score in a data set with mean $\overset{―}{x}$ and standard deviation $\sigma ,$ we can use the following formula:

$$
x=\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma 
$$

Substituting $x=12.1,$ $\overset{―}{x}=10,$ and $z=1.05$ into the formula and solving for $\sigma ,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma  \\ 12.1 & =10+1.05\cdot \sigma  \\ 2.1 & =1.05\cdot \sigma  \\ \sigma  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
